chapter_title_en: Reincarnation Unveiled: The Tragedy of Dongliu Xue
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 489: Reincarnation of Ji Ning's Parents - Judge, Karma & Escape
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning confirms his parents' reincarnation in the Wuqiong World. Watch their tragic love story unfold as a corrupt Immortal forces them to elope into the wilderness.
og_title: Ji Ning Sees His Parents Fall in Love All Over Again
og_description: In a chapter of quiet heartbreak, Ji Ning watches his reincarnated mother Dongliu Xue and father Liu Hechuan choose love over clan, fleeing into a chaotic world.
twitter_title: The Corrupt Immortal vs. The Eloping Cultivators
twitter_description: Dongliu Xue escapes a forced marriage and elopes with Liu Hechuan. Ji Ning watches his parents' second life unfold, full of love and danger.

lore_anchors.definition: A localized recreation of the original Six Paths of Reincarnation, established by Daofather Crimsonbright to maintain order after the cosmic war shattered the original system.
A cosmic bureaucrat in the underworld who passes judgment on souls, determining their next reincarnation. Judges are bound by the Heavenly Dao and punished for unfair rulings.
A form of spiritual credit accumulated through good deeds. High enough merit can lead to a favorable reincarnation; heavy sin attracts retributive punishment.
A corrupt cultivator of the Huashan Immortal Sect who uses his position to demand a young woman as a maidservant, triggering the chapter's conflict.
A high-standard set of betrothal gifts in Xianxia culture, symbolizing a man's sincere intent to marry.
A powerful one-use talisman that allows the user to instantly teleport over long distances, often used as an emergency escape tool.
A spell or technique used by King Yan to view the past lives of souls, showing their journey through reincarnation from the moment of rebirth.
